submitted.rationale: I had only 3 merit measurements. Copper vanadates are known to absorb at 2.06 eV, so I tested high-Cu compositions first. Cu-rich 114 gave a negative EQE and Cu:V ~0.6 at 66 gave about 0.013%, so EQE rose as Cu dropped toward V-rich compositions. Index 47 (Ca0.19 Cu0.19 V0.63), which the GP suggested along that trend, gave 0.131% EQE, the highest measured.
